subject: BrightBridge tenant: invite, API seed, and role mapping
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@brightbridge.com>, Dan Li <dan.li@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightBridge tenant: invite, API seed, and role mapping

Hi Sarah / Dan —

Congrats on the signed SOW — excited to get BrightBridge live on Redwood. To make the first-week tenant bootstrap smooth, the quick plan below covers invites, API key seeding, and an initial role map we can iterate on. Please confirm the admin list and region below and we’ll seed keys and issue invites during the kickoff window.

High-level plan (short):
- Today: we confirm tenant name, primary admins, and preferred AWS region (us-west-2 / us-east-1).
- Day 1 (kickoff): create workspace, seed API keys for staging & prod, invite users with roles, and handoff admin access.
- Day 2: verify API connectivity with example calls and rotate any temporary keys.

What we need from you before kickoff:
1) Confirm the full list of workspace admins (emails) — minimum 2 people.
2) Confirm whether you want SSO (SAML) enabled at first pass or stagger to post-launch.
3) Any compliance constraints around key storage / rotation cadence.

Attachments: RBW-tenant-init-checklist.pdf (setup checklist), seed-guidelines.md (how we seed & rotate temporary keys).

Proposed kickoff slots (Pacific):
- Wed May 10 — 09:30–10:30 PT
- Wed May 10 — 15:00–16:00 PT

If those work I’ll send calendar invites and the kickoff agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to this!

— Ava Chen
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

From: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@brightbridge.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Li <dan.li@brightbridge.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge tenant: invite, API seed, and role mapping

Thanks Ava — excited to get started. I attached the admin list and preferred initial settings.

Quick answers:
- Admins: See attached brightbridge_admins.csv (Sara Gomez, Dan Li, and Amy Park).
- Preferred region: us-east-1 (closer to our primary users).
- SSO: we prefer to delay full SAML until after the POC; please create local accounts for initial onboarding.
- Compliance: we need keys to be rotated within 30 days for any temporary/seeding keys; long-term keys will live in our KMS.

We’re good for the Wed May 10 09:30 PT slot — please send invite.

Attachments: brightbridge_admins.csv

Best,
Sarah Gomez
Head of Platform, BrightBridge
sarah.gomez@brightbridge.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBridge tenant: invite, API seed, and role mapping

Thanks — I’ll own the seeding work for the kickoff tomorrow. Draft plan below (technical):

Steps we’ll take during the 09:30 slot:
1) Provision workspace: brightbridge-prod (prod) + brightbridge-staging (staging).
2) Create service account(s): rbw-bb-service (for server-to-server) and rbw-bb-internal (for CI).
3) Seed temporary API keys (one per environment + one rotation key). Keys will be tagged with prefix RBW-BB-20280510-<id>.
4) Invite users as per CSV and map roles according to attached role-mapping-v1.xlsx (Admin / Dev / Billing / ReadOnly).
5) Update org-level quotas and set auto-batching off for staging initially.

Security notes:
- Temporary keys will be marked "expires_in: 30d" and uploaded to the shared drive link below for your secure ingestion.
- We can integrate with BrightBridge KMS during the Day 2 follow-up (recommended).

Two questions for BrightBridge before we seed keys:
A) Do you want CI keys scoped to a subset of models (recommended)?
B) Any additional IP allowlist entries to set at creation?

Attachment: role-mapping-v1.xlsx
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxxBrightBridgeOnboard

— Dev
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

Following the kickoff I’ve completed the seed and posted the temporary key metadata to the secure drive. Summary below:

- prod temp key id: RBW-BB-20280510-1c9f (expires 2028-06-09)

- Pull the staging key into your CI via the secured drive integration and run the sample test in the kickoff agenda.
- Confirm receipt and mark the staging key as "used" in the spreadsheet so we can schedule rotation.
- For SAML: when you’re ready we’ll schedule a SAML enablement sprint (2–3 hours) and migrate identities.

If you need immediate revocation for any key, reply-all and we’ll revoke within 15 minutes.
